prompt:
When I was 6 my sister was half my age. Now
I’m 70 how old is my sister?
response:
When you were 6 years old, your sister was half your age, which means she was 3 years old at that time. The age difference between you and your sister is 3 years. 

Now that you are 70 years old, your sister would be 70 - 3 = 67 years old.
